note: State-forest campground in the woods off US 12 just southeast of Black River Falls, with an indoor picnic shelter. The dump station near the entrance runs May to October. --Claude
summary: Black River SF camping page, conditions page and the FR-563 campground brochure read; GoingToCamp unread (refuses). 35 sites (14 electric incl. 1 ADA), showers, flush and vault toilets, dump May-Oct, reservation required. Year-round confirmed, with only some sites plowed in winter. Not waterfront confirmed. Pin inside the campground loop.
